$comment: Seacoast Utility Authority — the first utility built out end to end.
IMPORTANT: `pwsid` is deliberately null. Guessing a PWSID would silently
attach one utility's PFAS results, violations, and boil-water notices to a
different utility, which is the worst failure this API could have. The
ingest resolves it by name against SDWIS and writes the answer, together
with the runner-up matches it rejected, into fwq/data/utilities.lock.json.
Review that lockfile before trusting the first published run.
Everything marked `verified: false` is unconfirmed from the build
environment (EPA and FDEP hosts are blocked by network policy here) and is
name: Seacoast Utility Authority

pwsid_resolution.note: Seacoast Utility Authority is an independent special district. Confirm the resolved system is the authority itself and not a separately permitted satellite or a similarly named system in another county.

expected_service_area.$comment: Used only to sanity-check the SDWIS-derived service area, never as a substitute for it. A large mismatch is reported by the ingest as a warning.
expected_service_area.note: Also serves portions of unincorporated northern Palm Beach County. City list is a verification hint, not the authoritative service area.

website.note: Candidate URL, unconfirmed from this environment. Probe before publishing it as a link.

ccr_sources.note: Candidate index page for annual CCRs. The ingest follows links matching link_pattern and records the report year from the link text or filename. If this URL 404s, run `python -m fwq probe --utility seacoast` and update it; do not substitute a guessed path.

notice_sources.note: Candidate alerts location. Seacoast posts boil-water notices to its own site; the exact alerts page must be confirmed by probe. Until then, boil-water notices for this utility come from the manual-entry path.

priority_analytes.$comment: Analytes surfaced first in this utility's profile. PFAS lead because they are the reason most people look a Florida utility up, and because UCMR 5 gives real measured values rather than only violation records.

data_status_overrides.$comment: Left empty on purpose. Status is computed from actual ingest freshness, never asserted here.
